recentItems.title: Mirzapur: The Movie Box Office: ₹132 Crore Worldwide, Beats Alpha & Overtakes Hanuman Ansh
recentItems.description:
Mirzapur: The Movie is proving a massive box-office success. In just three days, the gangster action thriller has crossed the ₹100-crore mark worldwide and is now the number one film at the Indian box office. The film had a spectacular opening on Friday, earning ₹25 crore at the domestic box office. The strong response was especially visible in the mass centres of Uttar Pradesh and Bihar. On Saturday, Mirzapur: The Movie jumped more than 25 per cent to collect ₹32 crore. The film continued its winning streak on Sunday, earning another ₹36 crore. 

#mirzapurthemovie #mirzapur #bollywood #bollywoodnews

recentItems.title: Rani Mukerji & Abhishek Bachchan to REUNITE after 20 Years for Shah Rukh Khan’s King?
recentItems.description:
Could King bring together not one, but two nostalgic reunions? Siddharth Anand’s action thriller, headlined by Shah Rukh Khan, is generating buzz for its ensemble cast. Now, reports suggest that Rani Mukerji and Abhishek Bachchan could reunite on screen in the film, nearly two decades after they last shared the frame in the 2007 film Laaga Chunari Mein Daag. 

#king #ranimukerji #abhishekbachchan #bollywood #bollywoodnews

recentItems.title: Sanjay Dutt’s Reply To Maharashtra Minister’s ‘Speak Marathi’ Request Leaves Everyone Stunned
recentItems.description:
Sanjay Dutt showed his signature sense of humour at an event in Mumbai, when Maharashtra Transport Minister Pratap Sarnaik asked him to speak in Marathi. The actor was on stage with Sarnaik and other dignitaries. During the event, the minister spoke about promoting the Marathi language and joked about getting Sanjay Dutt to speak in Marathi. In videos from the event circulating on social media, Sarnaik is heard saying, “Aajkal main sab logon ko Marathi sikha raha hoon.” He then continued in Marathi and said, “ So I thought after his entry, let us all get Sanjay Dutt to talk in Marathi. He speaks in Hindi, but all of us understand Marathi.” Watch the video. 

#sanjaydutt #pratapsarnaik #bollywood #viralvideo #viral #bollywoodnews
